content.comment_body: I would like to download the registered data from my [product_name] over IP and manually generate CSV files on my computer every few hours. I'm not sure if using VB programming or something similar would allow me to access these data registers.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a way to access and download registered data from a [product_name] device via IP, aiming to manually create CSV log files on their computer. They are unsure whether this can be accomplished through programming like Visual Basic and if direct register access is possible. Lack of clear guidance or official support for this process leads to uncertainty for users wanting to automate or manually extract data from [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to have a straightforward method to directly access and download data from [product_name] over IP for generating local CSV files, hoping for either built-in support or at least a documented approach to achieve this.
